physical_hold_names_mapping: unknown; retain hold/hold_b code names, do not infer push/pull
vote_rule: door tasks only; sum current Q per frozen candidate answer including abstention; ties choose answer of highest-ranked candidate; diagnostic only
dprime_response_subset: two door predicate names only; excludes silence and other names
dprime_extreme_rule: if either H or F is 0 or 1, add 0.5 to all four response contingency cells
world1_same_door_names: normal and exception door predicates coincide; count shared name under normal, exception column is not applicable
correct_definition_above: at least one actual gated frozen candidate answers truth
correct_definition_below: none above, but at least one candidate answers truth in posthoc projection/filling with only the gates removed; never used to choose/learn
correct_definition_absent: neither actual gated nor posthoc ungated candidate answers truth
task_instruction_assumption: 本人にドア課題の指示が伝えられるとみなしheld_out_is_doorを使う
